senses.gloss: आ॑ञ्जन n. ointment, esp. for the eyes.

अञ्जलि॑ m. the two hollowed hands put together (as a
measure or a token of reverence). ˚लिं कृ or बन्ध् put the hands
together and raise them to the forehead.
अञ्जःसव॑ m. rapid preparation of Soma.
आ॑ञ्जनगन्धि a. smelling of ointment (v. prec.).
